en.help.mesh.symmetry_plane: Create a scan-linked mirror plane from an origin and normal or three manually picked corresponding point pairs. Then align the scan to a CSYS plane.
en.ui.scan_align.pair_help: Pick Left 1, Right 1, then the next two corresponding pairs on the same scan. Spread pairs over the scan; matching accuracy determines the plane.
en.ui.scan_align.complete_pairs: Pick all three corresponding point pairs.
en.ui.scan_align.same_scan: All six points must belong to the same scan.
en.ui.scan_align.invalid_vector: Enter finite coordinates and a non-zero normal vector.
en.ui.surface_match.help: Pick one source boundary edge and one fixed neighbour edge for G0, G1 or G2 matching. The neighbour and farthest opposite line stay fixed; other source boundaries can reshape. One edge pair per match: edit the existing match for adjustments. Chained matches and multi-edge continuity networks are not supported. Leave source edges empty for legacy matching (including G3).
en.ui.surface_match.bad_scale: Enter a positive finite derivative scale.
en.ui.surface_match.source_error: Pick source boundary edges on the moving surface.
en.ui.surface_match.explicit_edges: Explicit boundary matching needs one source edge, one target edge, and G0, G1 or G2 continuity.
en.ui.scan_align.offset_help: Offsets follow the target CSYS axes: XY uses X/Y, XZ uses X/Z, YZ uses Y/Z. Drag U/V arrows to move within that plane.
en.ui.surface_match.metrics_help: Sampled checks describe the tested seam stations. Algebraic bounds describe the supported affine construction. Source displacement is movement from the original sheet, not scan-fitting error.
en.ui.scan_align.workflow_help: Define and align the scan before fitting CAD patches. Linked construction planes move with the scan; existing independent CAD sheets do not. Pair residuals measure the selected landmarks only.
